components.text: The Blood Altar's main use is the production of Slates. Each tier of slate requires the previous tier and a more powerful altar than the last.

$(b)Blank Slate$(/b) and $(b)Reinforced Slate$(/b)
Crafted at a Blood Altar. The Blank Slate is the base tier used to craft many of the mod's basic tools and sigils; the Reinforced Slate follows on from it at a higher altar tier.

$(b)Imbued Slate$(/b) and $(b)Demonic Slate$(/b)
Crafted at higher-tier Blood Altars, using the previous slate tier as an ingredient. These unlock more advanced sigils and tools.

$(b)Ethereal Slate$(/b)
The highest tier of slate, crafted at a high-tier Blood Altar from Demonic Slate.
